what: 2026-11-14: execution cards were approved and then failed within milliseconds (localhost:8080, admission refusals) because the command carried no cluster connection flags and did not fit the executor's admission policy (v3).
check: Lint the card's command text (kubectl must carry its connection flags) and show the executor's admission policy when the card is built.

what: 2026-11-14: cleaning four retired Tekton definitions in cicd was approved but the executor shell container hit its 1Gi limit (OOMKilled) and wrote nothing.
check: A command that lists objects must page and bound its output; the card page shows the executor's memory limit.

what: 2026-11-14: a cleanup card reported FAIL with changed=0 although the objects were gone: the dry run used kubectl delete --raw, which really deleted.
check: Lint refuses --raw in card commands; a dry run may only be --dry-run=server.

what: 2026-11-14: platform PROD release to 1399e532 carried a table-dropping migration; the card said migrations run with the release, but PROD migrations do not, and the run was refused at the migration check (approved for nothing).
check: Refuse a release card when the PROD schema version is below the migration files in the diff, and point to the migration Job (infra k8s/agentrt-migrate/README.md).

what: 2026-11-14: a Tekton soft-affinity card was approved while the release window was held; its preflight answered 'release window held' and wrote nothing.
check: Card commands that need a free window or no run in flight wait for it with a bound (done in #560); the card page shows who holds the window.

what: 2026-11-14: the same soft-affinity card was built twice (#560 new, #561 old).
check: Refuse to build a card when an open card of the same kind exists for the same repo or object, or mark the older one superseded.

what: 2026-11-14: a platform PROD card showed '@ main' with only the pipeline name in key_params, while the platform took a revision nested in params; the right commit ran, and #563 released it a second time.
check: The card face shows the revision the run will use; the parameter shape is fixed to a top-level revision.

what: 2026-11-14/15: platform PROD cards pinned a commit that soon was no longer the one STG ran, so pinned_to failed; three cards were built in a row.
check: When a release card is built: the revision equals what STG runs, main is not ahead of STG, and no ci/landing run is in flight; once STG moves on, pending release cards are marked stale.

what: 2026-11-13/14: the Owner approved cards within 61 seconds, before the draft reached duty and before the number reached the coordinator; #528 was approved by mistake.
check: A card needs a 'draft checked' record before it is built, or a machine-enforced minimum time between creation and approvability.

what: 2026-11-14: a switch turned on in STG platform-workers read all 1073 retained runs (32 MB) and the pod was killed at its new 512Mi limit for 11 minutes.
check: Before turning on a new switch, measure its peak under the same limit; a card that changes a workload's limit names who is changing that workload's function.

what: 2026-11-14: a decoupling card was built before duty answered the draft review.
check: Same as L-528: a 'draft checked' record before the card is built.
